issues.title: M1: M1-28 Light survival needs: hunger and thirst never kill
issues.excerpt: Decision "Survival needs are light" (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-08): hunger and thirst never kill. Today EL_SurvivalStats.UpdateStats drains hunger at 0.1/s and thirst at 0.15/s, so a player reaches 20 within 9 to 13 minutes.

issues.title: M1: M1-27 Murder makes you wanted; the spawn is a safe zone

issues.title: M1-25: One-street town layout

issues.title: M1: M1-13 Counter screens: ATM terminal and shop price list on the UI kit
issues.excerpt: ATM and shop are the two menus every player uses. They are old MenuManager menus; the shop menu opens for the local player regardless of who interacted (features.md).

issues.title: M1: M1-24 Playtest release: guide, Workshop, showcase
issues.excerpt: M1 is published on the Workshop, hosted from the maintainer's PC, and collects feedback through GitHub issues. docs/playtest.md still describes Workbench play.

issues.title: M1: M1-23 Journey proof on a dedicated server
issues.excerpt: M1 is done only when every loop is proven from the player's view on a dedicated server with several clients, including a restart.

issues.title: M1: M1-22 Town tidy
issues.excerpt: A stranger walks past debug clutter: visible EL_DebugAreaBoundary markers on ATM, Shops, Jobs, NPCs, Survival, chain layers, test fixtures (PRFeatureCrate 176,130, Tests.layer), and duplicate stations. The town spans x 94 to 243.

issues.title: M1: M1-21 Jail you can see
issues.excerpt: Arrest, escort, and the timed sentence work (LF_Jail.c), and #77 persists the sentence, but the prisoner gets no in-world statement of the sentence and release is silent.

issues.title: M1: M1-20 Alarm and dispatch
issues.excerpt: Police learn about a robbery only from a toast (and toasts are broken until #97). Decisions: feedback from the world first; period comms (radios, pagers); major crimes need police online.

issues.title: M1: M1-19 Fine as a paper ticket
issues.excerpt: Fines are a remote menu action that takes cash from a wanted player at any distance (EL_PoliceMenu.RpcAsk_EL_PoliceFine; #73 adds a range). The police menu is otherwise a stub. Decision "In-world first" lists a fine ticket as a real item.

issues.title: M1: M1-18 Guided arrival chain
issues.excerpt: Decision "Short guided arrival, then free". The quest giver at spawn (QuestGiver_Start at 110,137) offers test quests (talk, kill, timed). The quest system has no events for job runs, ATM deposits, or reading a sign.

issues.title: M1: M1-17 Organization registry: ledger desk and invite by facing
issues.excerpt: The org desk screen lists name, fund, and the processing upgrade, but invite/kick exist only in EL_OrganizationManager and are unreachable from the world.

issues.title: M1: M1-16 Garage it to keep it: garage pad, ledger card, impound
issues.excerpt: Decision "Garage it to keep it". Today retrieve spawns at the lot pad, not the garage; the LF_Garage catalog screen is unreachable from the world and duplicates the lot's buy path; vehicles left on the street have no rule.

issues.title: M1: M1-15 Hideout stash that holds items
issues.excerpt: Roadmap_Hideout_Stash is a crate mesh with no storage component (features.md, playtest.md). An organization cannot keep anything.

issues.title: M1: M1-14 Contraband: real cargo and real drop points
issues.excerpt: The convoy hauls RowanBerries.et between two EL_DebugAreaBoundary markers (Roadmap_Convoy_Start/_Drop). A stranger cannot tell it is contraband or where to go.

issues.title: M1: M1-12 One player interaction menu
issues.excerpt: Decision "One player interaction menu": introduce yourself, show ID, give cash or an item, and role actions (search, cuff, fine) on the person in front of you.

issues.title: M1: M1-11 Police station on the street: duty desk and wanted board
issues.excerpt: docs/playtest.md says go on duty at Roadmap_Police_Desk, but that desk has no components at all (Roadmap.layer, 204 0 120); duty lives at PoliceStation_Debug (170,120) on another layer.

issues.title: M1: M1-10 Progression survives a restart
issues.excerpt: Job careers and levels, police rank and on-duty seconds, licenses, and quest turn-ins are not in EL_PlayerAccountRecord; a restart returns officers to patrol and couriers to level 1 (features.md: LF_PoliceRanks ⚠, Jobs ⚠).

issues.title: M1: M1-09 Place the signs: one per site, town map at spawn
issues.excerpt: M1 "done when": a sign at spawn explains the loop, every site has a sign saying what it is and how to use it.

issues.title: M1: M1-08 Registration form and a real ID card
issues.excerpt: The name/age screen is never opened: EL_CharacterCreationManager.CreateAndSpawnDefaultCharacter makes every character "Default Citizen". IDCard.et exists but nobody receives it, and EL_ShowIDAction shows a toast.

issues.title: M1: M1-07 Pay at the counter: remove the passive paycheck
issues.excerpt: EL_PlayerJobComponent pays $700 cash every 300 s to every job including UNEMPLOYED (EL_PlayerJobComponent.c ~line 63).

issues.title: M1: M1-06 Filming harness
issues.excerpt: Direction: "Filming harness records the same runs as video: short clips attached to PRs". Nothing records video on main. Draft #111 (ws/filming-harness) is the spike: ffmpeg ddagrab + h264_nvenc, film a flow, clips as release assets.

issues.title: M1: M1-05 Multi-client harness on a dedicated server
issues.excerpt: The harness runs only in Workbench play as host. M1 must prove every loop on a dedicated server with several clients. No dedicated + multi-client + restart session has ever been recorded.

issues.title: M1: M1-04 Carried inventory and cash survive a restart
issues.excerpt: Every restart hands a fresh starter kit: carried cash and items are not persisted (audit). "Restart keeps what they earned" fails for everyone who did not bank at the ATM.

issues.title: M1: M1-03 Playtest host: mission, server config, `cli host`, auto-load
issues.excerpt: Playtests are hosted from the maintainer's PC on a dedicated server. Today the only scenario is the test-suite mission, and #77 documents -loadSessionSave but nothing loads the last save on restart, so "restart keeps what they earned"...

issues.title: M1: M1-02 Town manifest and `report town`
issues.excerpt: report roadmap only walks Roadmap_ entities. The town also includes the ATM (ATM_Debug 139,130), shops (144,130), traders, job center (118,120), spawn (100-110,130-137) and the police station (170,120).

issues.title: M1: M1-01 Diegetic sign system with a Read card
issues.excerpt: Decision "Signs are diegetic, with a Read for detail". The only signs today are EL_MiningSign and EL_WhitelistSign, which draw floating debug text through DebugTextWorldSpace (Scripts/Game/Components/Signs/EL_TextLabelComponent.c).

issues.title: M1: M1-00 Split the street into site layers
issues.excerpt: Roadmap.layer holds 24 sites and AGENTS.md forbids editing it unless a task names it. Every M1 site scope would collide on that one file. Splitting it once lets later scopes each own a layer.

milestones.title: M2
milestones.description: Living Town. Four themes: moderation (incident log + Game Master tools), medic (downed state + EMS + ambulance), comms (payphones, pagers, dispatch board), investigation (witnesses + evidence). Closes with Everon placement from reusable site prefabs. Outline: docs/roadmap/m2-outline.md

issues.title: Physical store: goods on shelves, pay at the till, shoplifting alarm (M2)
issues.excerpt: Maintainer decision (2026-11-08, from the M1 playtest): a dual store system. - Keep the price-list UI (improved in M1: bigger, clearer) as the convenient way to buy.

issues.title: M2 epic: Investigation (witnesses + evidence)
issues.excerpt: Gives police work between chases and makes the vague-description wanted system real: witnesses describe, evidence connects, an ID check identifies.

issues.title: M2 epic: Comms (payphones, pagers, dispatch board)
issues.excerpt: Every service (police, medic, taxi, mechanic) needs a way to be called. 1989 comms only, no phone UI.

issues.title: M2 epic: Medic (downed state + EMS + ambulance)
issues.excerpt: A third role with its own loop. Reforger's medical simulation does half the work, and the M1 hospital respawn (#121) gives it a destination.

issues.title: M2 epic: Moderation (incident log + Game Master tools)
issues.excerpt: Moderation decides whether a life server survives. An incident log the server keeps (deaths, damage, cash moves, intent, zone crossings) lets an admin rule from facts inside vanilla Game Master.
